setup.zh: 出了雍往东，两山夹着一条窄路，是函谷关。关令站在关门下拦住你，不看你的文牒，只说：你要走了，给我留一卷书。东边的天上，有一团紫气。
setup.en: Out of Yong and east, a narrow road runs between two mountains: the Hangu Pass. The keeper of the pass stands under the gate and stops you — not to see your papers, but to say: you are leaving; leave me a book. In the eastern sky hangs a cloud of purple air.

recap.zh: 到了函谷关，关令像当年留住老子那样，请你留下一卷书；东边的天上有紫气。
recap.en: At the Hangu Pass the keeper asked, as one of his line once asked Laozi, that you leave him a book; in the east hung a purple air.

text.zh: 第九鼎……就在前面。我感觉得到它，也感觉得到——水上只剩我一个了。
text.en: The ninth cauldron… just ahead. I can feel it. And I can feel — there's only one of me left on the water.

alone.zh: 第九鼎就在前面。东边的水上，只剩一轮月。
alone.en: The ninth cauldron lies just ahead. On the waters to the east only one moon remains.

text.zh: 关令说：往东，是洛邑。九鼎当年立在那里。
text.en: The keeper says: east lies Luoyi. The nine cauldrons stood there once.

exits.means: goes east through the pass to Luoyi

text.zh: 你出了关往东走。伊、洛、瀍、涧四条水在前面的平原上汇着，平原当中是一座城。
text.en: Out of the pass and east. Ahead on the plain the Yi, the Luo, the Chan and the Jian run together, and in the middle of the plain stands a city.

exits.means: writes something down for the keeper of the pass, leaves him a book as Laozi did

text.zh: 你想了想，写下一路走过的八州：哪条水，哪口鼎，哪个妖，哪句话。关令接过去，说：够了。当年那位老先生写了五千言，也是这样走的。
text.en: You think a while, then write down the eight provinces you have walked: which river, which cauldron, which creature, which saying. The keeper takes it and says: enough. The old master who passed here wrote five thousand words, and went on just so.

alone.zh: 书的最后一页，你画了一轮月。
alone.en: On the last page you draw a moon.

exits.means: asks the keeper about the purple air in the east

text.zh: 关令说：紫气东来，是有人要过关。上一回，是一位骑青牛的老先生。
text.en: The keeper says: purple air from the east means someone is coming through the pass. The last time, it was an old master on a grey ox.
